verdict.rationale: Muse's Goals tab and activity log suggest it can track and manage ongoing tasks with an audit trail of completed/planned actions, implying some form of persistent task tracking, but there is no explicit documentation of recurring/scheduled triggers or a scheduling UI. Community evidence also shows the agent's control plane can time out under stress, raising doubts about reliability for automated recurring runs. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/recurrence configuration docs, evidence of one-off vs recurring task setup, and independent confirmation that scheduled tasks reliably complete and report back.
